full_judgment: Md. Gholam Rabbani J: These two appeals which will be disposed of by this analogous judgment are from the same decree passed in TS No. 665 of 1985 Appellant in FA No. 313 of 1993 was the defendant No. 1 and appellant Nos. 1 and 2 in FA No. 194 of 1993 were respectively defendant Nos. 7 and 8, while respondent No. 1 in both the appeals was the plaintiff in that suit. The suit property is a one-storied building bearing plot No. 6 of the residential area known as "Pallabi" within PS Mirpur, Dhaka. Suit was for three declarations; that the plaintiff has title to the suit house, that the suit house is not an abandoned building and that a sale deed on which defendant No. 7 claims title to the suit house is void. Suit was also for recovery of khas possession of the suit house. Admittedly, original owner of the suit house was one Akhter Hossain and it is mortgaged to House Building Finance Corporation. Defendant No. 5 is possessing the suit house as a lessee under the Government.
